ev.q: On August 17, 2023, genomic sequencing identified BA.2.86 in a pooled sample of swabs from 10 TGS participants
Testing and sequencing of the individual samples confirmed the presence of BA.2.86 in one individual sample on August 20.
This sequence was the second publicly reported BA.2.86 sequence in the United States and the seventh reported globally,
CDC’s Traveler-based Genomic Surveillance (TGS) program was developed to provide early warning of new variants entering the United States

methods_quotes.q: If a pooled sample tests positive, it undergoes viral genomic sequencing.
A maximum likelihood phylogenetic tree was generated using iqTREE software (version 1.6.12) with 1,000 bootstraps.
